title: Keya House Warm Line:
title_short: Keya House Warm Line · Somewhere You Can Call
headline: The warm line is a real person with lived experience who picks up and talks with you. Not a call center, not a crisis line.
story: A phone rings at Keya House and Madison picks up.
Amber explains: call and talk with a peer for up to 15 minutes about anything, and it doesn't always have to be a struggle. It is not a crisis line; for crisis there is 988.
A warm line is just a safe space to talk with a peer. If you're struggling, call this number.
do: Open on the ringing phone with “Someone will pick up.”
Cut to Madison's real calls over Amber's lines.
Keep the 988 line and put it on screen.
End card: “If you're struggling, call this number.” + the number + logo, 5 s.
dont: Not therapy, diagnosis, treatment or crisis. Not a hotline, hospital or office.
Don't type a phone number from Google. Use the number MHA gives us.
No guest face without a signed release. No street number on screen.
No desk, keyboard or paper filler B-roll.

rows.visual: C4689 00:00: the Panasonic cordless phone on the wooden table, an incoming call on its screen. Madison picks up at 00:02.
rows.motion: Hook text on frame 1, big and bold: Someone will pick up. No logo, no name plate.

rows.visual: Amber on camera (green MHA shirt, seated) for 3 s, then C4691 00:00: Madison on the phone, glasses, patterned curtains, green wall.
rows.motion: Super once, lower corner, 3 s: “Amber Pendley · Director of Operations, MHA Nebraska”. Caption “Keya” (transcript: Kea).

voice.quote: Go ahead and give Keya House a call and you will connect with a peer and you can talk to us for up to 15 minutes about anything that you are or may be struggling with or maybe you just want someone to talk to.

rows.visual: C4691 00:56–01:01: Madison laughing on the call.

voice.quote: It doesn't always have to be a struggle.

rows.visual: Amber on camera 4 s, then C4667 00:00 phone close-up, then C4693 00:07 Madison on the flip phone in the MHA sweatshirt.

voice.quote: One thing that I wanna reiterate is we are not a crisis line. … We do intentional peer support where we just wanna support you in your wellness journey but we do not handle crisis over the phone.

rows.motion: Text card: <q>In crisis? Call or text 988.</q>

voice.quote: So there are other alternatives for crisis like the 988 number if you do find yourself in a crisis
